content: Do good and cast it into the rushing river; even if the fish does not know, God knows.
author: Persian Proverbs
sourceWork: To niki mikon o dar dejleh andaz (تو نیکی می‌کن و در دجله انداز) — Saadi's Bustan
explanation: If you perform charity only so the recipient grovels in gratitude, or so your name is chiseled into a plaque, your virtue is merely commercial trade. Cast your kindness into the stream like breadcrumbs: let it float away in total obscurity, knowing heaven registers the deed.
practicalInsight: Perform an act of quiet service or generosity today that no living human will ever discover was done by you.
reflectionPrompt: How much of your good behavior is motivated by the desire to be seen, applauded, and remembered?
